items.q: What does Sadia Khan say people confuse with 'who they attract'?
items.a: **Who they entertain.** Most people can attract almost anyone. Low self-esteem normalizes unavailability, then they attach to the people who produce anxiety.

items.q: If similarity feels like settling, what is actually wrong?
items.a: **The standards**, not the match. You are asking someone to fill a self-worth gap (40-year-old on divorce two demanding a 25-year-old; not working but wanting a six-figure entrepreneur).

items.q: What is ghosting evidence of, according to Khan?
items.a: **Poor communication** — alternatives, coping, or low digital investment. Don't personalize app disposability; lose attraction to people who cannot communicate.

items.q: What is the unconscious helping contract?
items.a: I heal you (money, trauma, addiction) so you **must** love and stay. They never signed. Recovered partners often leave for someone with a **higher selection bar**.

items.q: What is Khan's formula for a masculine boundary?
items.a: **Stern and sensitive** — name the limit and remind her you love her and want the relationship. Abuse is all stern; people-pleasing is all sensitive.

items.q: How do you show you are helping from love, not approval-seeking?
items.a: **Deal-breakers.** A doormat with no limit on gratitude, respect, honor, or loyalty signals low self-esteem, not devotion.

items.q: What three equal ingredients do women need to fall in love?
items.a: **Attraction, admiration, adoration.** Miss any one and it ends fast (toxic) or slow (nice-guy / no-admiration fade).

items.q: What three ingredients do men need?
items.a: **Lust, labor, loyalty.** Being 'cool / low maintenance' blocks labor and keeps you a fling. Loyalty is reciprocated; without lust, porn wins.

sections.title: Date vs marry, sex pace, cheating

items.q: What is the difference between the woman a man dates and the one he marries?
items.a: **Self-control** — sex, body, money. Party-life is a great date and a daily-anxiety husband. Hedonism is slow suicide; you become a mother to a child you never wanted to adopt.

items.q: When is same-day sex fine, and when is it not?
items.a: Fine if **psychological intimacy** (aligned 5–10 year vision) is already there. Chemistry is easy. Sex without that drags a dead horse and drops self-esteem.

items.q: How do you immunize yourself against being cheated on?
items.a: Meet real needs, and they must know **you would leave**. 'I'll love you regardless' teaches unconditional disrespect. Withdraw access if they keep pushing.

items.q: Why do ultimatums produce unhappy marriages?
items.a: Men **pushed** into a ring resent the chores of marriage (check-ins, bedtime, kisses). Ask: is he, as he is now, someone you can marry — not his potential.

items.q: What is Khan's best relationship advice in the Final Five?
items.a: **Pick peace over pleasure.** Worst advice: you're somebody's dream girl. Love should not be unconditional. Adoration without attraction feels like neediness.

items.q: Where is closure if they will not talk?
items.a: In **their behavior**, not a last conversation. Ego wants the last word. Soul already knows: if they were right, you would not be suffering.
